mapper.select: SELECT id, subject_type, subject_id, mobile_ciphertext, mobile_hash, masked_mobile, encryption_key_id, status, verified_time, replaced_time, version FROM public.auth_mobile_binding WHERE subject_type = #{subjectType} AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND status = 'VERIFIED' AND is_deleted = false LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.auth_mobile_binding ( subject_type, subject_id, mobile_ciphertext, mobile_hash, masked_mobile, encryption_key_id, status, verified_time, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{mobileCiphertext}, #{mobileHash}, #{maskedMobile}, #{encryptionKeyId}, 'VERIFIED', #{verifiedTime}, #{subjectId}, #{subjectId} ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE public.auth_mobile_binding SET status = 'REPLACED', replaced_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{subjectId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{bindingId} AND subject_type = 'TENANT_ACCOUNT' AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND status = 'VERIFIED' AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE public.auth_mobile_binding SET status = 'REVOKED', updated_by = #{subjectId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{bindingId} AND subject_type = 'TENANT_ACCOUNT' AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND status = 'VERIFIED' AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = false
mapper.select: SELECT subject_id FROM public.auth_mobile_binding WHERE mobile_hash = #{mobileHash} AND subject_type = 'TENANT_ACCOUNT' AND status = 'VERIFIED' AND is_deleted = false ORDER BY subject_id ASC LIMIT 100
